mapper.select: SELECT specialized_services_idx, service_homepage_id, service_name, description, link_url, view_yn, org_file_name, server_file_name, file_extension, file_size, add_id, add_date, modify_id, modify_date FROM CMS_SPECIALIZED_SERVICES WHERE specialized_services_idx = #{specialized_services_idx}
mapper.insert:
SELECT NVL(MAX(specialized_services_idx),0)+1 FROM CMS_SPECIALIZED_SERVICES
INSERT INTO CMS_SPECIALIZED_SERVICES ( specialized_services_idx, service_homepage_id, service_name, description, link_url, view_yn, org_file_name, server_file_name, file_extension, file_size, add_id, add_date, modify_id, modify_date ) VALUES ( #{specialized_services_idx}, #{service_homepage_id}, #{service_name}, #{description}, #{link_url}, #{view_yn}, #{org_file_name}, #{server_file_name}, #{file_extension}, #{file_size}, #{add_id}, SYSDATE, #{modify_id}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT specialized_services_idx, service_homepage_id, service_name, description, (SELECT homepage_name FROM CMS_HOMEPAGE WHERE homepage_id = service_homepage_id) AS service_homepage_name, link_url, view_yn, org_file_name, server_file_name, file_extension, file_size, add_id, add_date, modify_id, modify_date FROM CMS_SPECIALIZED_SERVICES WHERE view_yn = 'Y' AND ROWNUM <= 20 ORDER BY add_date ASC
